messages.content: When should metformin be started for type 2 diabetes?

Metformin should be started as first-line therapy for adults with type 2 diabetes when initial insulin treatment is not required. It is recommended to introduce metformin after the resolution of ketosis or ketoacidosis if present. Additionally, when starting initial therapy with metformin and one or more other medicines, metformin should be introduced first, and its tolerability should be checked. If using an SGLT-2 inhibitor, it should be started as soon as metformin reaches the maximum tolerated dose. If using a GLP-1 receptor agonist or tirzepatide, this should be started as soon as the SGLT-2 inhibitor is at the maximum tolerated dose.
